title: Pehle kisko dena hai?
caption:
Thok wale ka bill is hafte aaya hai. Aapko pata hai pehle kisko dena hai? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a shopkeeper who sees which supplier bills are overdue and which fall due this week, so he knows who to pay first. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Meena: Meena is a confident woman in her thirties who runs a small garment shop, wearing a green cotton saree and glasses.
cast.Supplier: The supplier is a friendly middle-aged wholesaler with a round face, a white shirt and a bundle of bills.

scenes.vo: मीना की साड़ी की दुकान अच्छी चल रही थी।
scenes.sub: Meena ki saree ki dukaan achchi chal rahi thi.
scenes.art: Meena arranging colourful sarees on shelves in her bright small shop in the morning.

scenes.vo: पर थोक वालों के बिल कई थे।
scenes.sub: Par thok walon ke bill kai the.
scenes.art: Meena at the counter with a thick stack of paper bills in her hands, a bit overwhelmed.

scenes.vo: कौन सा बिल पुराना है? कौन सा इसी हफ़्ते का?
scenes.sub: Kaun sa bill purana hai? Kaun sa isi hafte ka?
scenes.art: Meena spreading the bills across the counter, comparing dates with a puzzled frown.

scenes.vo: पिछले महीने देर हुई थी, तो माल रुक गया था।
scenes.sub: Pichhle mahine der hui thi, to maal ruk gaya tha.
scenes.art: The supplier at the shop door shaking his head gently, a closed delivery crate behind him, Meena apologising.
Meena sitting on a cushioned seat in the shop, opening her phone with a determined smile.

scenes.vo: देनदारी में हर थोक वाले का नाम, अलग-अलग।
scenes.sub: Dendaari mein har thok wale ka naam, alag-alag.

scenes.vo: कितना बकाया है, और इस हफ़्ते क्या देना है।
scenes.sub: Kitna bakaya hai, aur is hafte kya dena hai.

scenes.vo: मीना ने सबसे पुराना बिल पहले चुकाया।
scenes.sub: Meena ne sabse purana bill pehle chukaya.
scenes.art: Meena handing a payment envelope to the supplier at the counter, both smiling.

scenes.vo: बाकी के लिए पैसे अलग रख लिए।
scenes.sub: Baaki ke liye paise alag rakh liye.
scenes.art: Meena placing folded notes into a small tin box labelled in Hindi for the week, tidy desk.

scenes.vo: ऐप तारीख़ से पहले याद भी दिलाता है।
scenes.sub: App taareekh se pehle yaad bhi dilata hai.
scenes.art: Meena's phone on the counter showing a small reminder bell glow, Meena looking relieved while folding a saree.

scenes.vo: आप पहले किसे पैसे देते हैं?
scenes.sub: Aap pehle kise paise dete hain?
scenes.art: Close-up of Meena smiling warmly at the viewer, shop shelves softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
